verdict.rationale: TypeSafe's docs include a dedicated cookbooks section of real end-to-end tasks: LLM guardrails screening with pass/review/block/route thresholds, hierarchical classification across patent, retail, biomedical and source-code taxonomies, reranking with measured top-1/top-10 gains, citation checking, and batched parallel questions with cost/speed benchmarks. Adaptable pattern guides (confidence routing, fan-out, composite scoring, intent routing) back these up. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the cookbooks are runnable and adaptable, and evidence of the depth of the cookbook code (e.g., linked runnable repos or notebooks).
